headline: Safaricom Reduces Ethiopia Unit Operating Loss by 96.5% to $3.3 Million
summary: Kenyan telecommunications group Safaricom cut EBITDA losses at its Ethiopian subsidiary by 96.5% to $3.3 million. The company targets operational break-even for the unit by March 2027.
why: Safaricom is East Africa's largest mobile operator and is expanding its network across Ethiopia.

impacts.name: Safaricom PLC
impacts.why: A significant reduction in subsidiary losses improves consolidated profitability.
